info.title: EASYCRED Partner API
info.description: EASYCRED-managed secure partner API. All requests require a Bearer API key plus HMAC request signing (X-Signature / X-Timestamp / X-Nonce). No raw customer PII is exposed by this version. Signing convention: the HMAC-SHA256 is computed over method, path, timestamp, nonce and the raw request body. For GET requests (and any request with no body) the body component is the EMPTY string '' — sign over '' for those requests.

bearerAuth.description: API key of the form ec_(live|test)_<prefix>_<secret>. Scopes are listed per operation.

LeadSummary.description: Application metadata only — never raw PII or encrypted fields.

WebhookSubscription.description: A registered webhook subscription (the signing secret is never echoed here).

subscriptionId.description: Stable id of the form whs_<uuid>.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint; must not target a private host/IP.

WebhookCreateResponse.description: Returned on create. The plaintext `secret` is shown ONCE — store it now.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Returned exactly once.

WebhookSecretResponse.description: Returned on rotate-secret. The new plaintext `secret` is shown ONCE.

secret.description: New HMAC signing secret. Returned exactly once.

NextAction.description: The mirrored next step the client must drive (POLL / REDIRECT / COLLECT / TERMINAL).

type.description: e.g. POLL_FOR_OFFERS, SELECT_OFFER, SUBMIT_BANK_DETAILS, REDIRECT_TO_KYC, COMPLETED.

UserDetails.description: Applicant details. Provide monthlyIncome OR annualIncome (at least one).

JourneyInitiateResponse.description: API_HOSTED returns a `hostedUrl` (single-use resume link to hand to the customer). API_HEADLESS returns a `journeySession` token. Authorize subsequent /action and /{journeyId} calls by passing it in the `journey_session` cookie OR the `X-Journey-Session` header — NOT in Authorization, which carries your API key.

journeySession.description: API_HEADLESS only — pass back via the journey_session cookie or X-Journey-Session header on /action and /{journeyId}.

branchLocationId.description: The chosen branch. This is the `id` of an entry in data.offers[].branchLocations[] returned by GET /{journeyId} while the journey sits at SELECT_GOLD_LOAN_BRANCH.

SubmitBankAccountPayload.description: Payload for kind=SUBMIT_BANK_ACCOUNT (the FSM step is SUBMIT_BANK_DETAILS).

JourneyRedirectReturnedRequest.description: Signal that the customer has returned from a hosted redirect step.

kind.description: The redirect step that was completed.

BranchLocation.description: A gold-loan branch the customer can collateralise at. Echo the `id` back as the `branchLocationId` in a SELECT_GOLD_LOAN_BRANCH action.

id.description: Send this back as `branchLocationId` on SELECT_GOLD_LOAN_BRANCH.

address.description: Full postal address (city/state are embedded here).

isSelected.description: Whether this branch is already the selected one.

JourneyOffer.description: A lender offer mirrored from the journey. Fields beyond those listed may be present (passed through from the lender) — rely only on the documented ones.

branchLocations.description: Present on gold-loan offers at the SELECT_GOLD_LOAN_BRANCH step. Pick one and send its `id`.

JourneyView.description: Mirrored journey state. Read-only off our DB; never exposes raw customer PII.

offers.description: Lender offers. On a gold journey at SELECT_GOLD_LOAN_BRANCH, each offer carries branchLocations[].

selectedOffer.description: The offer the customer selected, if any.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome (e.g. COMPLETED, REJECTED), if reached.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Suggested poll cadence for the current POLL step.

JourneyStateResponse.description: Mirrored journey view (offers, selectedOffer, nextAction, outcome). Read-only off our DB.

get.summary: List products enabled for the authenticated client (API-transactable products only).

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature over method, path, timestamp, nonce and raw body.

parameters.name: X-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix epoch seconds. Requests outside the tolerance window are rejected.

parameters.name: X-Nonce
parameters.description: Unique per-request nonce. Replays are rejected.

401.description: Authentication failed (missing/invalid key, signature, or replayed nonce).

403.description: Authenticated but missing the required scope / product access.
